description: This file contains image processing utilities for cropping, resizing, filling, and transparency handling within the Mattermost project, specifically in the imaging package.

methods.name: isFullyTransparent
methods.description: Checks if a color is fully transparent based on its alpha value.

methods.name: FillImageTransparency
methods.description: Fills transparent pixels in an image with a specified color.

methods.name: CropCenter
methods.description: Crops the image to a specified size centered on the image.

methods.name: resizeAndCropCenter
methods.description: Resizes an image to cover specified dimensions and crops it centered.

methods.name: FillCenter
methods.description: Creates a centered, scaled, and cropped version of the image with specified dimensions.

methods.name: Fit
methods.description: Scales down an image to fit within maximum width and height constraints.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to specified dimensions with a chosen resampling filter, preserving aspect ratio if needed.
